source: 9 V PP3 battery (IEC 6LR61 alkaline, IEC 60086-2): 26.5 x 17.5 x 48.5 mm maximum, snap terminals on one end. Terminal centre distance 12.7 mm and stud height 1.5 mm are typical (assumed, uncertainty +-0.5 mm); the snap clip and wire keep-out height is assumed (typical clip body 10 mm).
frame: battery: origin at the body min corner, long axis along Z, terminals on the +Z end face, 26.5 mm along X, 17.5 mm along Y

batt_width.source: IEC 6LR61: maximum width (long side of the end face)

batt_depth.source: IEC 6LR61: maximum depth (short side of the end face)

batt_length.source: IEC 6LR61: maximum height of the body

terminal_spacing.source: typical snap terminal centre distance, uncertainty +-0.5 mm

stud_height.source: typical terminal stud height above the end face, uncertainty +-0.5 mm

clip_height.source: assumed snap-clip body height over the end face, uncertainty +-2 mm

clip_width.source: assumed snap-clip width (about the battery depth), uncertainty +-1.5 mm

notes: The clip zone reserves room on the terminal end for the snap clip and its wires; it is deliberately larger than the studs. The pocket should leave a finger or pull-tab path, which is a design choice not data. Real cells are 0.3 to 0.5 mm smaller than the maximum; the maximum is used so the pocket never binds. Terminal spacing and stud height are assumed typical, not from a drawing.
